scientific_integrity: An explicit mathematical proof and reproducible standalone finite checks support the result. The reported self-review is not independent publication certification.
scientific_limitations: Only three equally spaced scalar samples of a known stable damped rotation with independent unit-variance observation noise. Unique optimum proved only for sufficiently small omega/a, not general frequency ratios, arbitrary time design or correlated noise. Historical priority against unlocated specialized earlier work remains uncertain.
title: Sharp strong-damping observability envelope for three-time oscillator sampling
